column1: # "Ironic" is not in the §4b taxonomy, and that is the right call - irony is a
# tone, not a mechanism. Inside this category the joke is built one of three
# ways, and they are not interchangeable:
#   md  claims a virtue the boat plainly does not have (Fuel Efficient)
#   lt  admits a defect in flat words (Sinks, Slow Leak)
#   dp  understates the admission (Mostly Sober, Unsinkable (Terms Apply))

column4: it is never the final boat
